verdict.rationale: Basecamp's own API repo points AI agents to first-party Basecamp Skills, and the pricing page advertises skills for AI agents. That is an agent-oriented knowledge artifact, but nothing shows an llms.txt or dedicated agent-readable docs pages, and the probe for a markdown docs variant returned a 404. missing for 10: llms.txt file, agent-oriented/markdown docs endpoints, documentation of what the Skills contain, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: CLI access and skills for AI agents you run on your computer.
